messages.subject: 如何解決 錯誤: 'predictions' contains NA. in ROCR package
messages.subject_clean: 如何解決 錯誤: 'predictions' contains NA. in ROCR package
messages.body_plain:
程式碼如下:
getwd()
setwd("C:\\Program Files\\R\\2")

Data1<-read.csv("NGAL run no NA.csv")
Data11<-Data1[Data1$DtW==1,]
Data10<-Data1[Data1$DtW==0,]
attach(Data1)

AE_glm1 <- glm(formula = DtW~ GDF.15..B., family = "binomial", data = Data1)
AE_glm2 <- glm(formula = DtW~ APACHE, family = "binomial", data = Data1)
AE_glm3 <- glm(formula = DtW~ GDF.15..B.+APACHE, family = "binomial", data = Data1)

result1 <- predict(AE_glm1, newdata = Data1, type = "response")
result2 <- predict(AE_glm2, newdata = Data1, type = "response")
result3 <- predict(AE_glm3, newdata = Data1, type = "response")

library("ROCR")
pred1 <- prediction(result1, Data1$DtW)
--> 但這裡就跑出 錯誤: 'predictions' contains NA
我爬文看有人說是版本4.0 vs3.6 問題,我換了版本還是一樣　請問有人有曾經的問題嗎？　那該如何解決呢？
perf1 <- performance(pred1, measure = "tpr", x.measure = "fpr")
